text:
Alex (Sales): Nexera sent over a SIG/CAIQ + a 50-question custom security questionnaire. POC starts on Mon (3 days). Can someone pick this up? They specifically call out encryption (in transit/at rest), SOC2 evidence, and data flow for embeddings/PII. Link: https://example.com/nexera/q1

Carla (SE): I can help with infra-level answers (network, TLS, key mgmt), but need a security owner for policy/controls and attestation items. Is this mostly CAIQ + extras or fully custom? Any immediate blockers from legal/contract side?

Ben (Security Eng): Looks like CAIQ + a set of customer-specific questions appended. I'll take ownership of the CAIQ portion. Quick question: will Nexera's dataset / embeddings be persisted to their S3 or kept ephemeral? that changes control mapping.

Alex (Sales): They said embeddings will be stored in their S3 (customer-managed) and they will provide IAM creds. We also have logs retained 30d per the draft contract. Primary contact: jordan@nexera.ai (cc'd in the intake email).

Sam (Compliance): Please confirm if any PHI/PCI is in scope. Also request a copy of the signed DPA and the scope for SOC2. If PHI is present we escalate to legal.

Ben (Security Eng): PHI is not expected per initial intake, but I'll mark as "confirm with customer". Action items for me: 1) pull CAIQ, 2) answer custom items, 3) request SOC2 evidence if not already provided. Can someone upload the questionnaire files to the shared bucket or attach here?

Alex (Sales): Uploaded both files to drive: https://drive.example.com/nexera/questionnaire.zip — includes CAIQ export + custom doc.

security-bot: New ticket created: SEC-2024-4823 — "Nexera security questionnaire" assigned to Ben (Security Eng). https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2024-4823

Carla (SE): For faster turnaround on common CAIQ items, here's a short reusable snippet we use (feel free to copy into the CAIQ answers):
```text
- Data flow: client data -> Redwood runtime -> embeddings persisted to customer S3 (encrypted with SSE-KMS)
- In transit: TLS 1.2+ enforced, cipher suites hardened
- Auth: OAuth2 + API keys, keys rotated per policy (90d)
- Logging: PII redaction at ingestion, 30d retention, access logged
```

Alex (Sales): Ben — what's your ETA? Customer is asking for answers before the kickoff.

Ben (Security Eng): I'll aim to complete CAIQ answers within 24 hours and the custom questionnaire within 48 hours (to allow for compliance/legal review). Need SOC2 Type II redacted report and DPA if available. Also will attach our public pen-test summary.

Sam (Compliance): Uploading SOC2 Type II (redacted) and DPA to shared folder now: https://drive.example.com/nexera/soc2. I'll also DM legal to confirm DPA terms.

Ben (Security Eng): Got the SOC2 link. Marking ticket SEC-2024-4823 as In Progress and setting ETA 48h. I'll post completed forms + attachments in the ticket and notify this thread when done.

Alex (Sales): Great — thanks everyone :thumbsup: If Nexera asks for a verbal walkthrough of answers during the POC kickoff, I'll set that up.

Carla (SE): If you want, I can join the kickoff to cover infra and runtime details.

Ben (Security Eng): Thanks. I'll ping here once the CAIQ is uploaded to the ticket for review.

Alex (Sales): Appreciate it.
